claims.disproof_condition: 條件：EPA 或州主管機關之後放寬表後燃機的 NOx BACT（例如 islanded 電廠豁免），或核發不需 SCR 的同級燃機許可。核查頻率：每季（EPA 新聞稿與州許可公告）。觸發後 48 小時：降這條邊 confidence，重讀排放控制層是否仍是必要層。
claims.statement: Mississippi DEQ PSD permit 0680-00119 (issued 2026-03-11) for MZX Tech LLC: seventeen Solar Titan PGM-130 simple-cycle natural gas turbines (16.5 MW each), each equipped with SCR and oxidation catalyst, with a NOx BACT limit of 2 ppmv at 15% O2. A regulator's binding requirement — the emissions system is not optional for this class of permit. The permit does not say what the power is for.

sources.quote: MZX Tech LLC 2875 Stanton Road Southaven, Desoto, Mississippi has been granted permission to construct air emissions equipment
Seventeen 22,100 Horsepower (HP) (16.5 Megawatt (MW)) (185.15 MMBtu/hr) Solar Titan Model PGM-130 Natural Gas-Fired Simple Cycle Combustion Turbines, each equipped with SCR and oxidation catalyst
NOx BACT: ≤ 2 PPMV at 15% O2 on a dry basis not to exceed 1.45 lb/hr per turbine (excluding startup and shutdown) and ≤ 5.6 tpy per turbine (including startup and shutdown)
